# hsm\-tool

```go
import "github.com/effective-security/xpki/cmd/hsm-tool"
```

Command hsm\-tool manages keys in a PKCS\#11 HSM, AWS KMS, GCP KMS or an in\-memory provider, and creates CSRs and certificates signed with those keys. See cmd/hsm\-tool/README.md for usage.
